<!-- hive-mind-solve-repository-mode -->

## Objective

Address every open issue listed below in [link-foundation/start](https://github.com/link-foundation/start) with a **single pull request**.

This issue was generated automatically by `/solve https://github.com/link-foundation/start` (repository mode). Native sub-issues and the complete closing-reference block below jointly define the required scope.

## Scope

- Open issues found in the repository: 5
- Issues requested in this single pull request: 5
- Issues selected for native sub-issue attachment: 5
- GitHub sub-issue limit per parent issue: 100

## Issues to address

- [ ] #240 Release / Auto Release are skipped on every push to main since #234, although all needed jobs succeed (nothing published since 0.38.0) — opened 2026-10-21
- [ ] #241 Daemon-restart exit evidence needs the host journal: with a mounted docker.sock (DooD) a daemon-restart kill is 'Exit evidence: unavailable' — opened 2026-10-21
- [ ] #242 Docker cgroup sampler: with a mounted docker.sock every round still starts a new docker exec and docker inspect (use one long-lived exec) — opened 2026-10-21
- [ ] #243 $ --status costs ~1 CPU-second and $ --list ~16 CPU-seconds with 39 records: the store is decoded several times per call and each record gets its own docker inspect — opened 2026-10-21
- [ ] #244 Docker isolation: opt-in --init so orphaned processes are reaped (hundreds of zombies per long-running task) — opened 2026-10-21

## Requirements

1. Read every issue listed above (including its comments) and fully implement what it asks for.
2. Do all of the work in this single pull request. Do not defer any listed issue to a follow-up pull request.
3. The pull request description **must** close this issue and **every** issue listed above, so that merging the pull request closes all of them at once.
4. GitHub requires the full closing syntax for each issue: one keyword per issue. `Fixes #1, #2` only closes `#1`. Use the block below verbatim (plus `Fixes #<this issue>` for this issue).
5. If an issue turns out to be already resolved or not reproducible, say so explicitly in the pull request description — but still keep its closing reference so it is closed on merge.

## Required closing references in the pull request description

```
Fixes #240
Fixes #241
Fixes #242
Fixes #243
Fixes #244
```
title: Address all 5 open issues in link-foundation/start
